tfn.s: One of the statue heads was more than one and a half metres tall.
tfn.why: The text says: "One statue head was about 1.6 metres tall."

tfn.s: Archaeologists found the statues close to a temple linked to a goddess.
tfn.why: The text says: "The objects were found near the remains of a temple linked to Isis, an important goddess in ancient Egyptian religion."

tfn.s: The statues will be moved to a museum in Cairo.
tfn.why: Not stated. The text does not say where the statues will be kept after the excavation.

tfn.s: The resident kept the stone and sold it privately.
tfn.why: The text says the opposite: "Instead, he reported it to the experts, and his decision led archaeologists to something remarkable."

tfn.s: Experts think the whole statue may have been over eight metres high.
tfn.why: The text says: "Archaeologists estimate that the complete figure may originally have been approximately 8.5 metres tall."

tfn.s: The resident received a payment from the antiquities authority.
tfn.why: Not stated. The text does not say whether the resident was paid.

tfn.s: Specialists inspected the stone before they started a rescue excavation.
tfn.why: The text says: "Specialists from Egypt's Supreme Council of Antiquities inspected the original stone and then carried out a rescue excavation."

tfn.s: Researchers already know exactly where the statues stood.
tfn.why: The text says the opposite: "There is still work to do before researchers can explain precisely where the statues stood and what purpose they served."

tfn.s: The find began with a local man telling officials about writing on a stone.
tfn.why: The text says: "In October 2026, a resident of Bahbit al-Higara, in the Nile Delta, reported writing he had noticed on a stone while working on nearby land."

tfn.s: Archaeologists remove an object first and record its position afterwards.
tfn.why: The text says the opposite: "Archaeologists record the layers of earth, nearby buildings and other finds before moving a piece."

tfn.s: Other inscribed stones have been reported in the same village.
tfn.why: Not stated. The text does not say whether any other stones have been reported in the village.

tfn.s: Specialists also found a block of pink granite that carried ancient writing.
tfn.why: The text says: "Specialists from Egypt's Supreme Council of Antiquities also uncovered a block of pink granite covered in hieroglyphs, the ancient Egyptian writing system."
